regressions.old: call timelock.queueTransaction(address target, uint256 value, string signature, bytes data, uint256 eta) with: args address(stor[s + sha3(sha3(proposalId, 11) + 3)]), stor[s + sha3(sha3(proposalId, 11) + 4)], 160, ceil32(_119) + 192, block.timestamp + _2, mem[.. len ceil32(_119) + ceil32(_122) + 64]
regressions.source: GovernorBravoDelegate.sol queueOrRevertInternal: timelock.queueTransaction(target, value, signature, data, eta)
regressions.issue: The only named timelock call loses its name and decoded head arguments: the selector stored at B is printed as 'mem[B len 4]'. The calldata copy in between writes at addresses using 96 * ((len5 + 31) / 32) while B uses 2 * Mask(250, 5, len5 + 31), so the store is apparently not forwarded.
regressions.rule: Normalise Mask(250, 5, x + 31) to 32 * ((x + 31) / 32) (= ceil32(x) when x + 31 does not wrap) before comparing addresses, so writes at B + 32 * q + c (c >= 4) are seen not to touch the selector bytes at B, and forward the selector store into the call.

improvements: P6 22 -> 0, P2 4 -> 3. In propose, each pair of start/end-block overflow checks with raw reverts became one line with SafeMath.add (which reverts 'addition overflow', exactly add256), 8 reverts decoded, 1072 -> 921 lines. VoteCast (castVote, castVoteBySig: empty reason as Array(len=0, data='')), ProposalExecuted (id=proposalId) and ProposalQueued are decoded. uint96 return values read uint96(ext_call.return_data[0]) instead of byte slices. queue's signature copy loops became copy lines (while 43 -> 40), and queuedTransactions' tx hash prints as sha3(target, value, 160, .., eta, ..). 2570 -> 2407 lines.
notes: Diff 1262 lines, 7 changed functions reviewed by skeleton comparison plus the changed regions read in full (castVote*, execute, queue, getActions, propose's checks). getActions: only the pointer variables were renamed and reused (u keeps the end of the targets data across the values loop); the ABI offsets derived from it (e.g. 192 + 32n + 32m) are right. propose keeps both getPriorVotes uint96 range checks, now on ext_call.return_data. cancel and the source loops are unchanged.
summary: Mostly improved (events and reverts decoded, propose's checks compacted, P6 gone), but one medium regression: queue's timelock.queueTransaction call lost its name and decoded arguments (selector printed as a memory slice).
